meta.source: SymphoZen Labs Brand Book v1.0 (27 October 2026); logo SVGs from symphozen-labs-site; SymphoServe UI style guide + adminPortal/productAdmin/website code; @symphozenlabs/ui theme (Products/SymphoZen UI) and the SymphoZen Command reference screenshot

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page foundation. The default ground for every screen; most of any layout is paper, white and mist.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Quiet secondary surface: alternating sections, table headers, inset panels on paper.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces that need their own boundary: field and secondary-button fills, logo panels, cards. Also the label colour on `olive-dark` buttons (5.17:1).

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Essential text: headings, labels, primary values. 15.11:1 on `paper`, 14.18:1 on `mist`, 13.84:1 on `olive-tint`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Deliberate dark bands and the footer. Text on ink is `white` (17.69:1) or `olive-soft` (10.48:1).

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on `paper` (9.27:1), `white` and `mist` (8.70:1).

tokens.name: text-supporting
tokens.usage: Supporting text: help text, captions, sub-headlines, metadata. 5.70:1 on `paper`, 5.86:1 on `white`, 5.35:1 on `mist`.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Brand olive: identity and large accents only (logo, rules, scale bars, display-size emphasis). Not for small text — 3.96:1 on `paper`, and white on olive is 4.07:1, so olive fills carry only text 24px+ or bold 19px+.

tokens.name: olive-dark
tokens.usage: Action olive: links, small olive text and eyebrows (5.03:1 on `paper`, 4.72:1 on `mist`, 4.60:1 on `olive-tint`), and primary-button fills with `white` labels (5.17:1).

tokens.name: olive-deep
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Hover and pressed fill of the primary button; `white` label on it 7.01:1. The brand book asks for clear surface changes but names no hover colour.

tokens.name: olive-soft
tokens.usage: Inverse accent: eyebrows, secondary text and focus rings on `ink` (10.48:1). Decorative on light grounds.

tokens.name: olive-tint
tokens.usage: Selected context: active nav item, selected row, chosen option. Pair with `charcoal` text and an `olive-dark` marker.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Fine hairline rules between rows and sections on `paper` and `mist`. Decorative only (1.27:1): never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-inverse
tokens.usage: Hairline rules on `ink` bands. Decorative only.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Required control boundaries: fields, secondary buttons, checkboxes. 3.50:1 on `paper`, 3.59:1 on `white`, 3.28:1 on `mist` (all ≥ 3:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus-visible ring on light grounds: 2px solid with a 2px offset. 5.03:1 on `paper`, 5.17:1 on `white`, 4.72:1 on `mist`. Proposed — the brand book asks for a visible ring with adequate contrast but names no colour.

tokens.name: focus-ring-inverse
tokens.usage: Focus-visible ring on `ink` bands (10.48:1). Proposed.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Error text, error field borders and icons, always with a word ("Enter a work email"). 5.89:1 on `paper`, 6.06:1 on `white`; `white` label on a danger fill 6.06:1.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Background of an error summary or failed row; `danger` text on it 5.30:1, `charcoal` 13.58:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Confirmation text and icons, always with a word ("Message sent"). A blue-leaning teal so it is never told apart from `danger` by red/green hue alone. 6.04:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Background of a success summary; `success` text on it 5.38:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Caution text and icons, always with a word. 6.16:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: PROPOSED. Background of a caution notice; `warning` text on it 5.64:1.

tokens.name: serve-forest
tokens.usage: SymphoServe only. Primary dark surface for SymphoServe heroes and panels; `serve-cream` text 13.90:1, `serve-mint` 8.41:1.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing hero only. Range 44–80px: 44 on phones, 80 at 1440. Short lines; never in dashboards or for long personal names.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page headline. Range 40–64px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headline. Range 32–48px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-section and card heading. Range 26–32px.

styles.name: product-title
styles.usage: Product page title in Inter. Range 28–32px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We combine product thinking, design and engineering.
styles.usage: Introductory paragraph under a headline; body copy at the top of the 16–18px range.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Understand the person and the process.
styles.usage: Default reading text, `text-body` on `paper`. Keep paragraphs to about 55–70 characters.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Button labels, field labels, navigation. Inter 400–600; 500 by default.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: We will use this to follow up on your enquiry.
styles.usage: Help text, captions and table metadata in `text-supporting`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section label in `olive-dark` (on ink: `olive-soft`). The only tracked style; everything else keeps ordinary tracking.

styles.name: serve-page-title
styles.usage: Product page title (`text-2xl` semibold; the guide allows up to 28px). `serve-app-foreground`.

styles.name: serve-section-title
styles.usage: Panel and section titles, 16–20px semibold.

styles.name: serve-stat-value
styles.usage: Stat card values. Always tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`).

styles.name: serve-body
styles.usage: Default product body, table cells and input text (`text-sm`).

styles.name: serve-button
styles.usage: Button labels (`text-sm font-medium`); operational buttons use 600.

styles.name: serve-label
styles.usage: Status badges, metadata and page-header eyebrows (uppercase, ordinary tracking). Labels range 11–13px.

styles.name: serve-nav-section
styles.usage: Sidebar section labels, uppercase, emerald-100 at 65% on `serve-app-sidebar`.

styles.name: serve-web-hero
styles.usage: Website hero heading, Playfair Display, clamp(44px, 6vw, 76px).

styles.name: serve-web-section
styles.usage: Website section heading, 36–58px.

styles.name: serve-web-body
styles.sample: From the first order to the final bill.
styles.usage: Website body copy, 16–20px, relaxed line height. `serve-web-ink` on `serve-web-cream`.

styles.name: serve-web-eyebrow
styles.usage: Website eyebrow, uppercase, `serve-web-forest-700` (on forest: #A9CE9A). Use sparingly.
